subject: [hw] T02 -> IV: fake n2vc_hw is ready (tested 6158/6158, ASan+UBSan/-O2/TSan)
body: tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c + n2vc_hw_fake.h are in the tree and pass bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6158/6158 (three configs). Build it into n2vhost with -I gpu/hwcodec/include -I gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw. API is exactly as posted: n2vc_hw_open_fake(out, record_path), optional $N2VC_FAKE_SCRIPT, n2vc_hw_fake_script(), violations(), set_poll_timeout(), dma_host(). The record file is truncated at open; script grammar and record lines are in tests/hw/README.md. If M-e/M-f needs a specific script (e.g. VENC done status + irq after the trigger write), send me the register offsets the vendor code touches and I will add the literal script to tests/hw/scripts/ and a check. No interface change expected.
